target:
def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℕ → Prop, REPred A →
    (∀ n, A n → ¬ ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code n).eval n).Dom) →
    ∃ k, ¬ ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code k).eval k).Dom ∧ ¬ A k
a_raw: {"translation":"Target is the proposition that for every predicate A on the natural numbers, if A is recursively enumerable and, for every natural number n, A(n) implies that the n-th program does not halt on input n, then there exists a natural number k such that the k-th program does not halt on input k and A(k) is false. The witness k may depend on A; no procedure for choosing it is required."}
translation: Target is the proposition that for every predicate A on the natural numbers, if A is recursively enumerable and, for every natural number n, A(n) implies that the n-th program does not halt on input n, then there exists a natural number k such that the k-th program does not halt on input k and A(k) is false. The witness k may depend on A; no procedure for choosing it is required.
